snippet.title: Play Operation Mania Online Game | Pogo Games Commercial
snippet.description:
Play Operation Mania and manage the mayhem of a wacky ER.  One of your favorite Hasbro  board games is now available  as a fun online game at Pogo.com.  Heres what youll find in Operation Mania: 
* 35 levels and 5 hospitals on a zany continent
* Upgrade hospital equipment and hire staff
* Earn outrageous ranks, patient badges, and tokens
* Refer patients to other players online
